$description: The shared content grammar for a resource destination and a Session-context capability's observed state (#3137). The two hosts keep different shell/navigation owners; the content region keeps one hierarchy. Long identities, paths and digests wrap at the value's own role instead of forcing horizontal overflow, and a read-only fact is never given input chrome. App local rows/actions still honour the touch floor. `parts` maps the recipe's stable data-recipe-part anatomy to the Experience typography role each part must resolve (#3138); on App the host header owns the surface name, so the app block deliberately has no detail-title.
